title: Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa elected president
summary: Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa was elected in the first round on 24 January 2016. A former leader of the PSD and, for two decades, the country's most watched political commentator, he ran on cohabiting with the two-month-old minority government rather than on obstructing it, and took office in March.
